L-Dis.name: L-Dis
L-Dis.summary: L-Dis is an Action game, developed by Dual and published by NCS, which was released in Japan in 1991.

Private Eye dol.name: Private Eye Dol
Private Eye dol.summary: Adventure game for the CD-ROM² addon for PC-Engine. The player navigates Mei around the environment, examining locations and items of interest, and talking to other characters. There are no puzzles in the game, with the plot advanced by triggering events. Items are used automatically in their corresponding locations.
